## What it is

Number 2, rendered yellow. Front-left, 225°. Recessed 2. Four openings, and the highest on the coil: 27, 53, 79 and 105 mm. The cut end is the centre of the top opening.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, flat face down. The C is cut into the outer face of the bar.
- Both ends carry a curved slot. The top one takes the disc. The recessed 2 is the only mark.
- The bore follows the helix tangent, 5.4° from horizontal.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't swap it with number 1. The tab fits every slot. The openings would no longer be one helix.
